title: Light an LED from a 5 volt supply

steps.say: Find the 220 ohm resistor, red red brown gold. Hold it up and ask me if you are unsure.
steps.check: The user is holding one resistor whose bands read red, red, brown, gold.

steps.say: Push the resistor into the breadboard so it bridges the center gap.
steps.check: One resistor is in the breadboard with its two legs on opposite sides of the center gap.

steps.say: Put the LED in. Its long leg goes in the same row as one end of the resistor.
steps.check: An LED is in the breadboard and one of its legs shares a row with one resistor leg.

steps.say: Run a jumper from the 5 volt rail to the free resistor leg's row, and another from the LED's short leg row to ground.
steps.check: One jumper links the positive rail to the resistor's free row and another links the LED's other row to the negative rail.

steps.say: Connect the supply. The LED should light up.
